sourceReview.reason: Rechecked full TheStreet Nov 10 report (https://www.thestreet.com/crypto/markets/binances-bstocks-leads-4-8b-tokenized-stock-market-with-31-share): it attributes approximately $4.8bn to Token Terminal on Nov 10, not the precise Nov 14 $4.81bn or 9.1x annual multiple. Full TokenPost Nov 11 tracker report (https://www.tokenpost.com/news/investing/54294) discusses 5,859 tokens across 18 chains and late-October $3.7bn-$4.64bn estimates, not this precise measurement. Castle Labs' full Nov 15 CoinGecko-based snapshot (https://castlelabs.io/research/tokenized-stocks) reports $2.77bn across 1,664 tokens, reflecting a materially different universe. No original dated comparable dataset or independent full-text verification of the exact headline figures and three supported facts. Retry no sooner than 2026-11-16T06:13:39Z.
